notes: Test and install continuation v2 E002 plus stage the Chrome extension as the wake consumer. Do not modify or install Tampermonkey. No live trading, paid actions, wallet/funds, credentials, or WSL remote Git writes.

from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import sys

home = Path.home()
bus_path = home / ".local/share/prediction-command-bus/command_bus_poller.py"
wake_dir = home / ".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
ext_dir = wake_dir / "browser_extension"

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("installed_cont_bus_e002", bus_path)
bus = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
assert spec.loader is not None
spec.loader.exec_module(bus)

cmd = {
    "schema": "PREDICTION_BRIDGE_COMMAND_V1",
    "task_id": "DEV-PRED-CONT-E002-CHECK",
    "action": "BRIDGE_PING",
    "created_at_utc": "2026-10-02T16:30:00Z",
    "route_task_id": "SESSION-ROUTE-E002-CHECK",
    "live_trading": False,
    "paid_actions": False,
    "wallet_actions": False,
    "intelligence_tier": "C",
    "issuer": {"model": "GPT-5.6 Sol", "reasoning_level": "UNAVAILABLE_TO_RUNTIME"},
    "auto_continue": True,
    "parent_continuation_id": "CONT-" + ("a" * 24),
}
ok, reason = bus.validate_command(cmd)
assert ok and reason == "OK", (ok, reason)

sys.path.insert(0, str(wake_dir))
spec2 = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("installed_cont_wake_e002", wake_dir / "bridge_server.py")
wake = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec2)
assert spec2.loader is not None
spec2.loader.exec_module(wake)

assert getattr(wake.Handler, "server_version", "") == "PredictionChatWake/1.3-continuation-v2"
assert hasattr(wake.base, "INFLIGHT"), "fail-closed inflight patch must remain installed"
assert wake.base.oldest_event is wake.continuation_oldest_event
if hasattr(wake.base, "ACK_HOOK"):
    assert wake.base.ACK_HOOK is wake.continuation_ack_hook
else:
    assert wake.base.release_lease is wake.continuation_release_lease

root = Path(os.environ["PRED_PROJECT_TEMP_ROOT"]) / "continuation-e002-installed"
data = root / "bridge"
routes = data / "routes"
outbox = data / "outbox"
states = root / "task-state"
for p in (routes, outbox, states):
    p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

wake.base.DATA_DIR = data
wake.base.ROUTES = routes
wake.base.OUTBOX = outbox
wake.TASK_STATE_DIR = states

source = "DEV-PRED-CONT-E002-SOURCE"
(states / f"{source}.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "schema": "PREDICTION_COMMAND_BUS_TASK_STATE_V1",
    "task_id": source,
    "status": "DISPATCHED",
    "auto_continue": True,
}), encoding="utf-8")

wake.continuation_ack_hook(
    {
        "event_id": "e002-source-result",
        "task_id": source,
        "message": "NIGHTSHIFT_WSL_RESULT_V1 task=DEV-PRED-CONT-E002-SOURCE status=PASS exit=0",
    },
    chat_id="chat-e002-installed",
    consumer_id="ext-e002-installed",
    already_acked=False,
)
records = list((data / "continuations").glob("CONT-*.json"))
assert len(records) == 1
record = json.loads(records[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert record["state"] == "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"

wake.continuation.maintain_for_chat(
    data_dir=data,
    task_state_dir=states,
    routes_dir=routes,
    outbox_dir=outbox,
    chat_id="chat-e002-installed",
    now=1000.0,
)
record = json.loads(records[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert record["state"] == "CONTINUE_QUEUED"
assert record["attempts"] == 1
event_path = outbox / f"{record['last_event_id']}.json"
assert event_path.is_file()

wake.continuation.maintain_for_chat(
    data_dir=data,
    task_state_dir=states,
    routes_dir=routes,
    outbox_dir=outbox,
    chat_id="chat-e002-installed",
    now=9999999999.0,
)
record2 = json.loads(records[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert record2["attempts"] == 1, "pending delivery must suppress duplicate retry"

event = json.loads(event_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
event_path.unlink()
wake.continuation_ack_hook(
    event,
    chat_id="chat-e002-installed",
    consumer_id="ext-e002-installed",
    already_acked=False,
)
record3 = json.loads(records[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert record3["state"] == "CONTINUE_SENT"
assert record3["last_acked_attempt"] == 1
assert record3["attempts"] == 1

manifest = json.loads((ext_dir / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
content = (ext_dir / "content.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert manifest["version"] == "1.0.0"
assert "async function pollWake()" in content
assert '"/next?chat_id="' in content
assert '"/ack"' in content
assert "exactUserTurnCount" in content
assert "pollAiOutbox();" not in content[content.index("  setInterval("):]
assert "pollOutbox();" not in content[content.index("  setInterval("):]

print("CONTINUATION_E002_INSTALLED=PASS")
print("WAKE_HANDLER=" + wake.Handler.server_version)
print("INFLIGHT_PATCH=PRESERVED")
print("COMMAND_BUS_METADATA=PASS")
print("QUEUED_SENT_SPLIT=PASS")
print("PENDING_RETRY_SUPPRESSION=PASS")
print("EXTENSION_STAGED=PASS")
